schema_donor.role: RBDParallel and RBDParallelStructure native JSON column schemas only

source.rule: A tree leaf may be another RBD. A passive parallel nested leaf operates one prioritized B link and activates healthy E after B fails; TSWOV controls delay. RBDTree NBREQ counts functional leaves and a switch may affect tree and mission states.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both arms convert with zero errors or unreviewed diagnostics, preserve populated authored tables on native import/export, and calculate nonempty SXO, event log and report.

Native event/mission/report evidence differs from the accepted parent or between the two nested arms in a way consistent with the source-defined B/E fallback. Exact B/A event timing/order and any switch or mission transition are empirical; do not assume common stochastic draws or that TSWOV affects mission outcome monotonically.
If native logs identify a switchover, reconcile its time with TSWOV and the 72-bin System report. If not, report only source-bound nested state and observed system criticality/mission outcome.
native_acceptance: Two unique serial guarded session-0 SSH runs with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report, event and inventory reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay; classify any rejected or non-discriminating arm as diagnostic rather than silently adjusting the frozen contract.
diagnostic_gate: Retain rejected or non-discriminating runs and raw evidence as diagnostic; revise with new version/run IDs rather than changing this frozen contract.
limits: One passive two-link nested leaf under a single A-root NBREQ3 tree, zero and 0.5-hour switch times, one seed/replication; other nested types, link orders, failures of E and online maintenance untested.
Nested path state is source-bound unless native output names it. No GUI drawing, population reliability or cross-engine claim.
